name: France
summary: Western European nation with diverse topographical basins and low grid carbon intensity anchored by domestic nuclear generation, expanding wind and solar capacity, and extensive agricultural and viticultural land use.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.92x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); urban Paris and Rhone corridor monitor winter particulate peaks.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; second warmest calendar year recorded by Meteo-France.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend across metropolitan French meteorological stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.7% share of global fossil emissions; benefits from deep power sector nuclear baseload.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: One of the lowest per capita footprints among G7 economies due to low-carbon electricity mix.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Total woodland coverage ~172,000 km²; continuous natural expansion over the past century.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Hydropower provided 11.2%, wind 9.3%, and solar 4.5% alongside France's dominant 64.8% nuclear generation.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 118 people/km²; urban population fraction is 81.8%.
